_purpose: Validates that O2 override (G01 + negative FCF + current ratio < 1.0) forces band to High Risk when pre-override score would have been Watchlist. Also validates that O2 fires independently of O1 — G02 does not fire here, so only O2 can rescue the band.

G02_going_concern._note: Crucial for test: G02 must NOT fire so O1 cannot activate — only O2 is available

G03_persistent_liquidity_stress.reason_not_fired: Only 1 consecutive period with current ratio < 1.0

G04_distributing_while_insolvent.reason_not_fired: No dividends declared during analysis window

G05_financing_dependence_for_payouts.reason_not_fired: Only 2 of last 3 years with FCF negative; below G05 threshold of >=3 periods

G06_technical_insolvency_trajectory.reason_not_fired: Declining but window start was recently positive; trajectory condition marginal

fundamentals_inputs._note_leverage: 5x is exactly at DEFAULT sector structural threshold (5x); half-threshold = 2.5x. At or above half but not above full -> 3 points.

findings.classification_reason: EBIT margin at 3%, well below DEFAULT sector norm range; no prior-period cycle-peak base to explain

_expected_math.fundamentals: profitability 5 (EBIT 3% in 0-10 band) + cash_gen 8 (FCF<0 latest AND <0 in 2 of last 3) + leverage 3 (5x at threshold, between half and full) + liquidity 6 (ratio 0.85 < 1.0) = 22
_expected_math.override_o1: G02 does not fire -> O1 does NOT fire
_expected_math.override_o2: G01 fires AND FCF -2B < 0 AND current ratio 0.85 < 1.0 -> O2 fires. Score forced to max(52, 60) = 60, band forced to High Risk
_expected_math.final: Score 60, Band High Risk, override_applied = O2
